# Ivo Sousa Martins

> Creative director based in Lisbon, Portugal. Brand identity, photography and film for brands, agencies and institutions in Portugal and abroad. More than 20 years of work across branding, digital design, photography and video. Works in English, Portuguese and Spanish.

## What Ivo does

- Creative direction: from first brief to final delivery, with hands-on design and production
- Brand identity and design systems for companies, events and political campaigns
- Film and video: branded series, documentaries, short form for social, editing and motion graphics
- Photography: travel and editorial photography, published on Unsplash and Pexels
- Web and UX: landing pages and website redesigns

## Selected clients and projects

- Partido Socialista: brand, campaigns and social for two national elections (2024)
- Câmara Municipal de Lisboa: Citizen Diaries (Lisboa Capital Verde 2020) and Momentum (Lisbon European Capital of Sport 2021), two documentary series, 24 episodes; and a website redesign (2022)
- Oz Energia: A Chama que nos Une, a branded documentary series now in its third season, plus reels and posts (design, producing and video editing, with Kitchenette)
- Santander, Ron Barceló and Cofidis: short form video for Instagram, with the agency Judas
- Lightfoot Travel: landing pages, Meta ads and print for a global luxury travel company (creative, graphic and UI/UX design)
- Uriage Portugal: advice-led reels for Instagram
- Madam Bō and Now Canal: posters, cards and a branded short film, with Kitchenette
- Praça Beato, Academia Socialista, 50 Anos do Direito em Portugal and the UTPR seminar: visual identities
